summary: Named on the Eastern US Lookouts site in Santa Rosa County; TopoQuest's gazetteer places a Munson Lookout Tower point at the record's coordinates. No build or fate source found.

evidence.supports: Munson listing gives Santa Rosa County as its county
Gazetteer lists a Munson Lookout Tower point at 30.863797, -86.876350
evidence.quote: Munson Lookout Tower Tower N30.863797° W86.876350°

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Eastern US Lookouts Munson page gives only a name and county. The tower appears only as a nearby-features row on TopoQuest's Bear Creek page, not on its own page. The record's coordinates match that row within about 0.0005 degrees, so the record likely came from it. The Munson Wikipedia article (fetched) has no tower mention. The story is about 60 words, below the 120-word floor; recommend the editor hold it or accept it as a stub. Do not treat the gazetteer point as proof that a tower stands.
